optimizedDescription.value: Indexes workspace code and specs into one graph with collision-free identities, config-relative lookup, and cross-workspace resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace Integration

## Rules

### Identity and lookup
- Files/documents MUST use globally unique identity:
  - Workspace: `{workspaceName}:{relativeToCodeRoot}` (example `core:src/index.ts`).
  - Project-global `graph.includePaths` outside workspaces: reserved `root:{projectRelativePath}`.
- Workspace `codeRoot` ownership wins over `root:`; physical file MUST NOT have both identities.
- `path` remains canonical identity for `SymbolNode.filePath`, symbol IDs, relations.
- Every node MUST store `configRelativePath`, relative to active `specd.yaml` directory; forward slashes, no leading `./`; outside files may contain `..`.
- CLI file selectors MAY resolve unprefixed config-relative paths; canonical identity unchanged.
- `SymbolNode.id = {filePath}:{kind}:{name}:{line}:{column}`.
- `SpecNode.workspace: string` MUST identify owning workspace. Spec IDs follow `{workspace}:{specPath}`; prefix comes from workspace `specd.yaml` configuration.

### Discovery and specs
- For each workspace `codeRoot`, discover from absolute `SpecdWorkspaceConfig.codeRoot`; prefix stored paths with workspace name.
- `discoverFiles` accepts root and emits root-relative paths; remains workspace-unaware.
- Index specs directly from each orchestrated workspace `SpecRepository`:
  1. identities: `repo.list()`;
  2. freshness: `repo.persistedStateHash()` (formerly `specHash`);
  3. content: `repo.artifact()` for `spec.artifacts[].filename` only; exclude metadata/lock sidecars; concatenate `spec.md` first when present, then remaining filenames alphabetically;
  4. metadata: `repo.metadata()`; when `null`, default title=`specId`, description=`''`, `dependsOn=[]`; never parse `spec.md` fallback;
  5. dependencies: `repo.readPersistedDependsOn()`;
  6. coverage: `repo.readPersistedImplementation()`.
- Indexer MUST NOT rely on CLI-precomputed semantics/callbacks.

### Cross-workspace resolution
- Pass 2 resolves relative imports within workspace; package imports via `packageName → workspaceName` from `LanguageAdapter.getPackageIdentity`; PHP qualified names globally.
- `SymbolIndex` MUST contain all workspace symbols before Pass 2.

### Index contract
- `IndexOptions` SHALL contain `projectRoot: string`, `workspaces: readonly ProjectWorkspace[]`, `graphConfig: ProjectGraphConfig`, optional `onProgress: IndexProgressCallback`, `chunkBytes: number`, `vcsRef: string`, and `vcsRoot: string | null`.
- `ProjectGraphConfig`: optional `includePaths`, `excludePaths`; optional workspace map with `allowedPaths`, `excludePaths`, `respectGitignore`.
- Remove `WorkspaceIndexTarget.specs` callback; pull from each `ProjectWorkspace` repository.
- CLI/MCP maps `SpecdConfig.graph` into `ProjectGraphConfig`.
- `IndexResult.workspaces` SHALL contain `WorkspaceIndexBreakdown[]`; each: `name`, `filesDiscovered`, `filesIndexed`, `filesSkipped`, `filesRemoved`, `specsDiscovered`, `specsIndexed`.

### `.gitignore`
- Per-workspace `respectGitignore` defaults `true`.
- True + non-null `vcsRoot`: load root and nested `.gitignore`; apply relative to containing directory; gitignore exclusion overrides `excludePaths` re-inclusion.
- Null `vcsRoot`: do not load repository-root `.gitignore`; MUST NOT probe `.git/`, `.hg/`, `.svn/`.
- False: ignore all `.gitignore`; only `excludePaths` controls exclusion.

## Constraints

- `@specd/code-graph` runtime-depends on `@specd/core`.
- One `.specd/code-graph.lbug` per project.
- `discoverFiles` workspace-agnostic; indexer owns prefix and `configRelativePath`.
- Spec resolution exclusively via `SpecRepository`; no filesystem fallback.
- File identity metadata changes, including `configRelativePath`, require full rebuild; existing stores incompatible.
